metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting air and somehow scared 1 poor soul? Valorant brain glitch!
metadata.description:
Tapping like I forgot this was a shooter
That 1 unlucky enemy probably replaying life choices
Did NOT deserve that accidental chaos but hey, free kill vibes
Click if your aim’s mostly ‘wait, what just happened?’ moments!

Tap if your aim’s mostly happy accidents too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
